owner_directive: Improve the eFV injury penalty to truly use injury HISTORY/severity (currently _injury_factor fires only on il_on).
verdict: COVERAGE-STARVED / LEDGER. No trained feature (resolved-cohort IL coverage ~0). No production ship. A bounded, default-OFF live overlay (EEPHUS_INJURY_HISTORY) is delivered as a ready-to-enable owner scaffold; it changes nothing while OFF. Revival trigger dated below.

il_history_source.note: IL tracking effectively began 2026-06 (placed_seen >= 2026-06-06); 993/1240 stints have since>=2026. Pre-2026 since-dates are a thin survivorship residue (stints still active/observable at first scrape).

trained_feature_coverage_resolved_cohort.description: il_stints_pre = IL stints strictly before the decision cutoff, already emitted (efv_dataset._injury_features) but INERT (not in _FEATURES_HIT/_FEATURES_PIT). For a trainable feature the resolved (debuted) cohort must carry pre-cutoff IL history.
trained_feature_coverage_resolved_cohort.conclusion: A TRAINED durability feature is IMPOSSIBLE. The forward-chained eval cohort (cutoff pre-2024, SCORED_YEARS 2020-2023) has ~0 pre-cutoff IL history. il_stints_pre stays emitted-but-inert (correct). This matches the 2026-06 tracking-start note in memory.

cross_section_confounded.description: il_history joined to career_war (realized MLB WAR), contemporaneous. This is what the LIVE overlay mostly keys on (993/1240 stints are 2026).
cross_section_confounded.conclusion: WRONG-SIGNED. Severe (60-day/full-season) and major (TJ/shoulder) IL players show HIGHER realized WAR/yr, not lower. This is a selection artifact: a 60-day IL requires 40-man / MLB status, so severe-IL players are disproportionately established (higher-WAR) MLB players. Not usable as a durability penalty.

forward_test_causally_valid.description: Pre-2026 IL history (since<2026) -> realized 2026 WAR, among career_war players with a 2026 season. History strictly precedes outcome.
forward_test_causally_valid.conclusion: CORRECTLY-SIGNED but statistically NULL and tiny (n=21, p=0.18; severe n=5). The 'no history' group is mostly UNOBSERVED (not confirmed healthy) since tracking began 2026-06, so even this contrast is weak. Directionally supports the owner hypothesis; nowhere near a shippable, bounded, signed-correct signal.

repeat_injury_variation.conclusion: The repeat-injury signal the owner asked for (multiple TJ / >=2 stints) has ZERO players matched to realized-WAR outcomes, and 96% of all IL players have exactly one recorded stint. No repeat-injury effect is measurable in this data.

step2_decision.trained_feature: NOT BUILT (coverage ~0 on resolved cohort). il_stints_pre remains emitted-but-inert.
step2_decision.live_overlay: DELIVERED as a bounded, default-OFF diff (EEPHUS_INJURY_HISTORY). Ships nothing: flag OFF => factor 1.0 => no change to any served grade/rank/surplus and no served-artifact regen. It is an owner-explicit scaffold, mirroring _age_factor/_role_factor (owner-directed policy dials the debuted-only eval cannot support), but MORE conservative (default-OFF, not default-ON) precisely because the ground truth is coverage-starved and the cross-section is wrong-signed.

overlay_spec.fires_when: flag ON AND player NOT currently on IL (il_on handled by existing _injury_factor, untouched) AND clearly-high-history: major-injury flag (TJ/UCL/elbow/shoulder/labrum) OR a severe stint (60-day/full-season) OR >=2 stints. A single minor 7/10/15-day stint does NOT fire (respects the 2026-07-17 healthy-player directive).
overlay_spec.bounds_a_priori: floor 0.85; tiers 0.85 (repeat major) / 0.90 (single major, >=2 severe, or >=3 stints) / 0.95 (single severe or 2 stints). Bounds are a-priori, NOT fit to data (the data cannot fit them).
overlay_spec.surfaced_as: 'Injury history' factor chip (distinct from the active 'Injury penalty' il_on chip).

revival_trigger: Re-run this ground-truth study when the 2026-tracked IL cohort matures into resolved outcomes, i.e. when prospects with 2026 IL stints debut and accrue first-6yr WAR (~2028-2030), OR when il_history back-population reaches >=100 pre-cutoff stints on the resolved debuted cohort (currently 2 hit / 0 pit). At that point re-test both (a) the trained il_stints_pre / il_severe_pre feature under the OOS bar and (b) the overlay sign on a real forward cohort; flip EEPHUS_INJURY_HISTORY default only on a signed-correct, significant pass.
